whatThisIs: A screen recording of the running application, driven by a scripted Playwright session against the real local API, with synthetic text-to-speech narration generated by ElevenLabs from docs/demo-narration.json. The walkthrough is captured one segment per narration beat and each segment is held to the length of the sentence spoken over it, so the picture and the voice align beat for beat. Not performed on camera.
whatThisIsNot: It is not a human presenter and not a person speaking, and the beat-level alignment is not frame-accurate synchronisation. It shows no sponsor and no live provider call.
credentialsUsed: none in this step; the narration step used ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the environment only

narration.alignment: one recorded segment per beat, each held to that beat's audio length
